text:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT: Elevated tail latency detected across router pool in eu-west-2. p99 > 1200ms, streaming stalls observed. Auto-pager triggered.
oncall-sam: I'm on it — collecting context. Which routes are noisy?
support-olivia: customer reports: multiple streaming sessions hang then reconnect. Affected region: eu-west-2, ~5% of requests. Support tickets coming in (TKT-5421, TKT-5422).
maya: telemetry: sudden ↑ in per-shard queue length on router-shard-7 and router-shard-9. Heatmap shows hot partition keyed to model-serving:open-llama-13b-route. p95 ~ 340ms -> normal, p99 spiking to 1.2s+.
lee: rolling-policy rollout completed ~ 15m before spike — weight redistribution to prefer local-zone shards. suspect: policy misassignment created concentrated hot shards.
taylor: can we confirm config? show the lb snapshot.
maya: pulling snapshot...
```
{ "router_policy_version": "v2.14.0-rolled", "region": "eu-west-2", "shard_weights": { "shard-7": 0.43, "shard-9": 0.41, "others": 0.16 } }
```
lee: whoap — shard-7/9 have >40% each. They shouldn't. that's the hot partition.
oncall-sam: immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback policy to v2.14.0-prev 2) force rehash / rebalance 3) route heavy keys to fallback pool. Which is fastest?
taylor: rollback is fastest if safe. but rollback may not immediately rebalance in-flight sticky sessions. fallback routing to reserve pool buys time.
raj-pm: customer impact = streaming stalls for some enterprise customers in EU. SLA risk if not resolved in 30m. prioritize fallback + rollback.
support-olivia: escalated to a named account (AcmeHealth) — they've got an in-progress demo. Legal ping.
infra-bot: Suggested command: `rbctl policy rollback --cluster eu-west-2 --to v2.13.8`
maya: running quick check of recent deploys and commit diff... found change: "prefer-local affinity weight normalization" introduced a rounding bug that can amplify weights for small shard sets.
lee: that matches symptoms. rounding + small shard set => two shards got disproportionately high weight.
oncall-sam: executing fallback routing now: `router-ctl set-route-priority --region eu-west-2 --route open-llama-13b-route --target reserve-pool`
taylor: starting reserve-pool failover. scaling reserve pool + routing.
```
# reserve pool scale
kubectl -n routers scale deploy reserve-router --replicas=8
```
infra-bot: reserve-pool scaled to 8 replicas. Routing change pushed.
maya: telemetry update: p99 dropping from 1200ms -> 520ms within 70s after failover. streaming stalls decreased, reconnects steadying.
lee: still seeing higher qlen on shard-9 but draining now.
oncall-sam: kick off rollback in parallel: `rbctl policy rollback --cluster eu-west-2 --to v2.13.8 --force` (scheduled).
raj-pm: please capture timeline and notify CS + legal. Also add mitigation steps to incident page.
support-olivia: notifying affected customers and creating incident status page.
maya: rollback complete. Confirmed policy v2.13.8 active. weight distribution now: shard-7: 0.12, shard-9: 0.10, others: balanced.
```
{ "p95_before": "340ms", "p99_before": "1200ms", "p95_after": "220ms", "p99_after": "260ms" }
```
lee: root cause: policy normalization bug in v2.14.0-rolled that magnified weights on a small shard set in region. regression introduced during canary.
oncall-sam: are there any customer errors that persisted? support-olivia: a handful of streams dropped; automated retry recovered many but three high-profile sessions required manual reconnect.
raj-pm: file follow-ups: 1) revert fix is live 2) add stronger canary checks for weight skew 3) add alert for shard-weight-imbalance > 20%
taylor: propose short-term rule: block rollout if max(shard_weight) - median > 0.25.
maya: adding an eval job that simulates small-shard sets and applies normalization check.
infra-bot: created jira INC-8421 with tags [routing][regression][eu-west-2].
support-olivia: CS update sent to impacted accounts, next update in 30m.
oncall-sam: logging timeline to postmortem. handing off to night oncall: @lee — you have the bridge at 18:00 UTC, include rollback summary and customer impact.
lee: got it. I'll keep bridge open for 2h and coordinate fixes.
raj-pm: good work. please record exact metrics and attach logs to the postmortem.
maya: attaching relevant snippets to the incident doc (config diffs, heatmaps, perf graphs).
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: routing policy rollback + fallback routing mitigated tail latency. Severity: Sev2. Root cause identified as policy weight normalization bug.
lee: closing live bridge in 25m, will hand to oncall rotation. Follow-ups: action items in INC-8421.
support-olivia: tagging customers for a post-incident review meeting.
lee: final note: avoid rolling policy changes during peak EU hours until additional checks are in place. :warning:
